title: 第十五章 高超手法第十六章 了事拂衣去
content_zh:
“另外，方便借柴火吗？”楚天舒问道，语气自然得像是在问今天天气如何。
“柴……柴火？”李嵩差点以为自己出现了幻听。
炼药师炼丹，哪个不是依靠自身修炼的火系灵力，或者收服了某种兽火、地火，乃至传说中的异火来加热药鼎？借柴火？这简直是闻所未闻！难道这少年连最基础的火系灵力都无法运用？那他还考什么炼药师？
看到李嵩脸上那毫不掩饰的错愕与疑惑，楚天舒心中了然。
没办法修为太低了，而且他走的是炼体路，目前无属性。除非日后有机会获得兽火或者异火才行。
不过炼体法可以开发身体，到丹心境时可以修炼出“真气”，具有极强的攻击力。
就在楚天舒准备简单解释，或者干脆自己寻找引火之物时，李嵩已经从最初的震惊中回过神来。
李嵩看出了楚天舒的窘迫：“是了。他一个灵泽境，哪能外放灵力啊。”
“何须柴火那般麻烦！”李嵩立刻开口，态度甚至比刚才更加热情了几分，“既然小友不便动用自身火灵力，那便由老夫来助小友一臂之力吧！能为小友这等天才控火，也是老夫的荣幸！”
说罢，他不等楚天舒回应，便上前一步，来到药鼎旁。只见他指尖飞快掐动一个灵诀，袖袍一抖，三颗龙眼大小、通体赤红的丹丸便激射而出，精准地落在药鼎底部的三个凹槽之内。
“燃！”
李嵩低喝一声，并指一点。那三颗赤红丹丸瞬间被引燃，“轰”的一声，喷吐出三道炽热的橘红色火舌，均匀地舔舐着药鼎的底部。火焰稳定而旺盛，温度显然被李嵩精准地控制在一个适合炼制一品丹药的范围内。
“此乃‘烈阳火种’，是以特殊手法将地火之精封存于耐火材料中制成，可持续燃烧两个时辰，温度稳定，最适合初学者……呃，最适合炼丹使用。”李嵩介绍道，差点说漏了嘴。
他这番举动，可谓是给足了面子，亲自为一名考核者控火，这在他数十年的考核生涯中，还是破天荒的头一遭。
楚天舒看了一眼那稳定燃烧的火焰，又看了看一脸热切的李嵩，微微颔首：“有劳李大师了。”
他并没有推辞，对他而言，用什么火焰都一样，只要能提供稳定的热源即可。李嵩的主动帮忙，倒也省了他一番手脚。
准备工作就绪，楚天舒的神色也认真了几分。他深吸一口气，目光再次游走在那些药材架上，这一次，他的眼神变得无比专注，仿佛整个世界只剩下那些药材和中央的药鼎。
他没有立刻动手，而是静静地站在那里，似乎在感受着药鼎被火焰灼烧后散发出的热量，以及空气中弥漫的淡淡药香。这是一种调整自身状态，与炼丹环境融为一体的过程，唯有真正的丹道大家才会注重这种细节。
李嵩屏住呼吸，不敢发出丝毫声响打扰，只是紧紧盯着楚天舒的每一个细微动作。
终于，楚天舒动了。

他脚步轻盈，如同穿花蝴蝶般在药材架前移动，手指精准地拈起一株株药材。
取药的过程看似随意，但李嵩却敏锐地注意到，他选取的每一株药材，其年份、品相、甚至采摘时保留的根须泥土痕迹，都似乎经过了他的考量，都是同类药材中的最佳选择！
“好犀利的眼力！”李嵩心中再次暗赞。
取完炼制凝血丹所需的凝血草、白蒲根、赤参粉等五六种药材后，楚天舒回到药鼎前。
他并没有像寻常炼药师那样，急不可耐地将所有药材一股脑地投入鼎中，或者严格按照顺序逐一投放。
只见他左手虚按在药鼎的一个进气口上，体内《人王经》悄然运转，一股极其微弱、却带着某种奇异律动感的灵力缓缓注入。这股灵力并非火属性，也并非直接参与加热，而是如同一种无形的协调者，悄然影响着药鼎内部的热力分布和气流的流转。这正是他运用了一丝空间属性的感悟，在微观层面调整鼎内环境！
与此同时，他的右手快如闪电，拿起一株凝血草，并未直接投入，而是五指微拢，以一种奇特的手法在草叶上轻轻一捋！看似随意的动作，却让那凝血草的叶片微微卷曲，其内蕴含的汁液和药性仿佛被瞬间激活，散发出的药香都浓郁了一分。
“这……这是‘醒药手法’？”李嵩瞳孔一缩，他只在某些极其古老的丹道典籍上见过类似描述的记载，据说能提前激发药材活性，使药力更易融合，但具体手法早已失传！他没想到，竟然在一个十四岁少年身上见到了。
下一刻，楚天舒手腕一抖，那株经过“醒药”处理的凝血草被投入鼎中。药材落入鼎内的瞬间，那原本均匀燃烧的火焰，仿佛被一只无形的手拨动了一下，火舌微微偏向一侧，使得鼎内受热出现了极其细微且短暂的变化。
而这变化，恰好让凝血草落入了一个温度稍低的区域，避免了被瞬间烧焦，而是以一种缓慢、均匀的速度开始枯萎、渗出精华。
“许久不炼药……技法倒是生疏了……”楚天舒心想道。前世他作为七品巅峰炼药师，技法比此时还高超百倍不止。
楚天舒手上动作愈加熟练，第二株，第三株，第四株……每一种药材投入前，楚天舒都会进行或轻或重的“预处理”，有时是轻捋，有时是指尖轻弹，瞬间刺激一下药材的某个部位。而每一次投入药材的时机、角度，以及随之而来的火焰细微变化，都妙到毫巅，仿佛经过了千万次的演练！
李嵩看得如痴如醉，眼睛都不敢眨一下：“这技法……简直神了……”
他感觉自己数十年的炼丹经验，在这个少年面前，简直粗陋得像是在烧火做饭！那些他从未想过，甚至无法理解的精妙细节，在楚天舒手中信手拈来，浑然天成。

content_en:
"Also, is it convenient to borrow firewood?" Chu Tianshu asked, his tone as natural as asking what the weather is like today.
"Cha... firewood?" Li Song almost thought he was hearing hallucinations.
When an alchemist makes an elixir, which one does not rely on the fire spiritual power he has cultivated, or has subdued some kind of animal fire, earth fire, or even the legendary strange fire to heat the medicine cauldron? Borrow firewood? This is simply unheard of! Could it be that this young man couldn't even use the most basic fire spiritual power? Then why should he take the alchemist exam?
Seeing the undisguised surprise and confusion on Li Song's face, Chu Tianshu understood.
There is no way his cultivation level is too low, and he is taking the path of body refining, so he currently has no attributes. Unless there is a chance to obtain beast fire or strange fire in the future.
However, the body refining method can develop the body, and when you reach the elixir state of mind, you can cultivate "true energy", which has extremely strong attack power.
Just when Chu Tianshu was about to give a simple explanation, or simply look for something to ignite the fire, Li Song had already recovered from the initial shock.
Li Song saw Chu Tianshu's embarrassment: "That's right. He is in the Lingze realm, how can he release his spiritual power?"
"Why bother with firewood!" Li Song said immediately, his attitude even more enthusiastic than before, "Since I can't use my own fire power, let me help you! It is my honor to control fire for a genius like you!"
After saying that, without waiting for Chu Tianshu's response, he took a step forward and came to the medicine cauldron. I saw him quickly pinching a spiritual secret with his fingertips, flicking his sleeves and robes, and three longan-sized red pills shot out and landed accurately in the three grooves at the bottom of the medicine cauldron.
"Burn!"
Li Song gave a low shout and pointed. The three crimson pills were instantly ignited, and with a "boom", three hot orange tongues of fire were spit out, licking the bottom of the medicine cauldron evenly. The flame was stable and strong, and the temperature was clearly controlled accurately by Li Song within a range suitable for refining first-grade elixirs.
"This is the 'Scorching Sun Fire Seed'. It is made by sealing the essence of earth fire in refractory materials using a special technique. It can burn continuously for two hours and has a stable temperature. It is most suitable for beginners...well, it is most suitable for alchemy." Li Song introduced, almost spilling the beans.
His move could be said to have given him enough face, and he personally controlled the fire for an assessor. This was the first time in his decades of assessment career.
Chu Tianshu glanced at the steadily burning flame, then looked at Li Song who looked eager, and nodded slightly: "Thank you, Master Li."
He didn't refuse. For him, it didn't matter what flame he used, as long as it could provide a stable heat source. Li Song's initiative to help saved him a lot of trouble.
The preparations were ready, and Chu Tianshu looked a little more serious. He took a deep breath and looked at the medicinal materials shelves again. This time, his eyes became extremely focused, as if there were only those medicinal materials and the medicine cauldron in the center left in the whole world.
He did not take action immediately, but stood there quietly, as if feeling the heat emitted by the medicine cauldron after it was burned by the flames, and the faint fragrance of medicine filling the air. This is a process of adjusting one's own state and integrating with the alchemy environment. Only true alchemy masters will pay attention to such details.
Li Song held his breath, not daring to make any noise to disturb, but just stared at Chu Tianshu's every little movement.
Finally, Chu Tianshu moved.
His steps were light, moving in front of the medicinal shelf like a butterfly through flowers, and his fingers accurately picked up individual medicinal herbs.
The process of picking the medicine seemed random, but Li Song keenly noticed that the age, quality, and even the traces of soil on the roots of each medicinal plant he selected seemed to have been carefully considered by him, and they were all the best choices among similar medicinal materials!
"What a sharp eye!" Li Song secretly praised him again.
After taking the five coagulant grass, white pu root, and red ginseng powder required for refining the coagulant pill,After six medicinal materials, Chu Tianshu returned to the medicine cauldron.
He did not impatiently put all the medicinal materials into the cauldron like an ordinary alchemist, or put them one by one in strict order.
I saw his left hand pressed on an air inlet of the medicine cauldron, the "Human King Sutra" in his body was quietly running, and an extremely weak spiritual power with a strange rhythm was slowly injected. This spiritual power is not of the fire attribute, nor is it directly involved in heating, but is like an invisible coordinator, quietly affecting the heat distribution and air flow inside the medicine cauldron. This is exactly how he used a hint of his understanding of the attributes of space to adjust the environment inside the cauldron at a microscopic level!
At the same time, his right hand was as fast as lightning, and he picked up a piece of coagulated blood grass. He did not put it directly into it, but slightly closed his fingers and gently stroked the grass blades with a strange technique! The seemingly random movement caused the leaves of the blood coagulation grass to curl slightly, and the juice and medicinal properties contained in it seemed to be activated instantly, and the medicinal fragrance exuded became stronger.
"This...is this the 'medicine awakening technique'?" Li Song's pupils shrank. He had only seen similar descriptions in some extremely ancient alchemy books. It is said that it can stimulate the activity of medicinal materials in advance, making it easier to integrate the medicinal power, but the specific technique has long been lost! He didn't expect to see it in a fourteen-year-old boy.
The next moment, Chu Tianshu flicked his wrist, and the blood coagulation grass that had been treated with the "awakening medicine" was thrown into the cauldron. The moment the medicinal materials fell into the cauldron, the flames that were burning evenly seemed to be stirred by an invisible hand. The tongue of the flames was slightly tilted to one side, causing extremely subtle and short-term changes in the heating inside the cauldron.
This change happened to make the blood coagulation grass fall into a slightly lower temperature area, avoiding being instantly scorched. Instead, it began to wither and ooze essence at a slow and even speed.
"I haven't refined medicine for a long time...I am unfamiliar with my techniques..." Chu Tianshu thought to himself. In his previous life, as a seventh-grade peak alchemist, his skills were more than a hundred times superior than at this time.
Chu Tianshu became more and more skilled in the movements of his hands. The second strain, the third strain, the fourth strain... Before each medicinal material was put in, Chu Tianshu would perform light or heavy "pre-treatment", sometimes by gently stroking it, sometimes by flicking his fingertips to instantly stimulate a certain part of the medicinal material. The timing and angle of each injection of medicinal materials, as well as the subtle changes in the flames that followed, were all wonderful, as if they had been rehearsed thousands of times!
Li Song was so mesmerized that he didn't even dare to blink: "This technique... is simply amazing..."
He felt that his decades of experience in alchemy were as crude as cooking in front of this young man! Those subtle details that he had never thought of, or even understood, were in Chu Tianshu's hands, and they were natural.
